title: justicia anagallis
intro: Justicia anagallis, commonly known as Dwarf Blue Star, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and oxidative stress, and may also help to improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Justicia anagallis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids and phenolic acids, that are known to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Additionally, its leaves and flowers have been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, headache, and digestive issues.
